name: Unvisited ground near Cheyava Falls
science_question: The rover saw this ground, 79 m from Cheyava Falls, but never drove onto it. Do the layers with 'leopard spots' continue beyond the sampled rock?
tasks: Walk to the target area and photograph it from about 5 m.
Look in reddish rock for millimetre-size light spots with dark rims and photograph any you find with a scale bar.
Note whether white calcium sulfate veins cross the rock here, as at Cheyava Falls.
